skill.summary: Analyzes code for bugs, security risks, complexity, and style, providing detailed issues and actionable improvement suggestions.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Code Reviewer skill.

- Provides automated code quality analysis, bug detection, and security audit.
- Detects code smells, complexity issues, and common security vulnerabilities.
- Suggests performance improvements and best practice adherence.
- Offers actionable fix recommendations with sample outputs.
- Supports flexible configuration of review rules and focus areas.
